# This directory contains data generated by the OSINT Hub ETL pipeline.
# It is intentionally tracked in git so that CI can commit updated records
# on the weekly sync schedule.
#
# Structure:
#   data/raw/         — downloaded Markdown source(s)
#   data/processed/   — parsed JSON records (pre-enrichment)
#   data/enriched/    — LLM-enriched JSON records (Phase 2+)
